title: Informative and scenic Seville bike tour
text: Very enjoyable ride around Seville with Claudia. Frequent stops for information and local history. Very pleasant and interesting route. Comfortable and good quality “power assisted” electric bikes meaning minimal effort on flat terrain even in heat of the afternoon. Free water. Strongly recommended to see lots of Seville in a couple of hours and the guiding means you go places you wouldn’t go if you just hired a bike.

author: Finberg777

title: Great bikes! Great service!
text: We did a self-guided tour from Seville to Cordoba to Granada. ElecMove provided us with the bikes, a route guide for a leg of the trip, and picked up our bikes when we reached Granada. They were incredibly accommodating and easy to work with. We had bike rental reservations with another shop, but the bikes turned out to be very low quality. We went to ElecMove with only a few days before our trip was supposed to start, and they completely came through for us. We rented the high-end mountain bikes, which were fantastic quality.
